# How much will Form 2290 cost you for each truck this year?

> Free Form 2290 heavy highway vehicle use tax calculator for owner-operators and small fleets: tax by weight category, partial-year proration by first-use month, logging and 5,000-mile suspended trucks, due dates and cost per mile. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
